blocker_assets.why: filter list headers of the bundled blocker (comments inside list files, not shown in the UI)

credits.why: the credits page lists the licences of what is inside the browser, including the inherited project; the notice is a licence obligation

hsts_preload_data.why: data of the engine's HSTS preload list, not text a person reads; an entry for a host only forces https to it

identifiers.why: names in code that no person reads and that are not worth a rename (a rename is a rebase cost): pref keys 'helium.*' and the constants that name them (prefs::kHelium*), class and namespace names (helium::, HeliumLayoutType, Helium*Handler), Mojo and message names ('getHeliumCrashReporting', 'setHeliumCrashReportingMode'), directory and file names (components/helium_services, helium_flag_entries.h, patches/helium), custom element names (settings-helium-services-page), the scheme constant content::kHeliumUIScheme (its VALUE is now 'atlas'), histogram enum labels, MAC_TEAM_ID in BRANDING (macOS only)

licence_comments.why: copyright and licence comments in json files; attribution must stay
